set_ablation: Same nodes, encoder, node-update MLPs and pooling; aggregate message is zero. No pairwise messages. Unused message parameters remain initialized identically.
selection: Choose family by validation MSE of its equal-weight three-seed ensemble; retain all families in final comparison.
freeze: Write selection with dataset, training-report and checkpoint hashes before test prediction.
test: One audit of all families; each seed, ensemble, per-match RMSE and signed calibration summaries.
uncertainty: Exact paired match-bootstrap distribution over 3^3 ordered resamples of the three test matches; descriptive only with so few clusters.
scope: Predictive xG-proxy error. No causal movement recommendation, xG transfer validation, or performance-based threshold changes.
